task.description: Produce a backend design artefact at src/design/idn-04-api-token-management.md for requirement IDN-04 (API token management). Define token lifecycle (issue, store, list, revoke, validate), storage model, hashing strategy, token identifier format, expiration semantics, and revocation guarantees. Specify integration boundaries with IDN-01 user registry, IDN-02 group management where applicable, and API-08 bearer auth middleware so IDN-04-issued tokens can be authenticated and authorized consistently. Include endpoint-level contracts, error taxonomy and HTTP mappings, security constraints (no plaintext token persistence, one-time secret display, auditability), and a traceability map from each acceptance criterion to concrete design elements. No source code changes in this step.
acceptance_criteria: Every IDN-04 acceptance criterion maps to explicit design elements
Token lifecycle and revocation semantics are fully specified
Persistent storage schema and token hashing approach are explicitly defined
Auth middleware integration path for token validation and role claims is explicit
Security constraints and error mappings are complete and testable

result.summary: Design artefact for IDN-04 API token management with lifecycle, storage/hash strategy, API contracts, and auth integration boundaries.
